note.zh: 关键参数与签名整理自官方手册，讲解文字与示例为本站原创。沙盒已支持的条目可直接运行；标注「沙盒」的差异以 Archicad 实际运行为准。
note.en: Signatures follow the official reference; explanations and examples are original. Entries supported by the sandbox run as-is; sandbox notes mark where behaviour is simplified.

desc.zh: 以当前坐标原点为一个角点，向 +X、+Y、+Z 方向生成长方体。三个参数都必须是正数。
desc.en: Creates a rectangular block with one corner at the current origin, extending towards +X, +Y and +Z. All three sizes must be positive.

desc.zh: 圆柱体：底面圆心在原点，向 +Z 方向长到高度 h。第一个参数是高度不是半径。
desc.en: A cylinder whose base circle is centred at the origin, growing to height h along +Z. The first argument is height, not radius.

desc.zh: 球心在原点、半径为 r 的球体。
desc.en: A sphere centred at the origin with radius r.

zh: r2 — 顶半径（0 即尖顶）
en: r2 — top radius (0 makes a point)

desc.zh: 圆台：底面圆心在原点，沿 +Z 长到 h。顶半径写 0 就是圆锥；顶半径大于 0 是截头圆锥。
desc.en: A truncated cone with its base circle at the origin, growing to height h. Set r2 to 0 for a pointed cone.

zh: h — 竖向总高（Z 向直径）

desc.zh: 椭球体，中心在原点。三个半径互不相等时得到三轴椭球；改 ry 等于 rx 就退化成回转椭球。
desc.en: An ellipsoid centred at the origin. Making ry equal to rx gives a surface of revolution.

commands.name: PRISM
commands.syntax: PRISM n, h, x1, y1, s1, … , xn, yn, sn

zh: xi, yi — 第 i 个顶点坐标
si — 顶点状态码：1 起点、0 中间点、-1 终点
en: si — vertex status: 1 first, 0 intermediate, -1 last

desc.zh: 把 XY 平面上的闭合多边形沿 +Z 挤出成柱体。参数必须一次给全，换行用续行（行尾逗号）。这是做异形截面的主力命令。
desc.en: Extrudes a closed XY polygon up the Z axis. All vertices must be supplied in one statement (continue lines with a trailing comma). The workhorse for non-rectangular sections.

commands.name: PRISM_
commands.syntax: PRISM_ n, h, x1, y1, s1, … , xn, yn, sn, …

zh: n — 轮廓与洞口的顶点总数
si — 状态码（1/-1/0，洞口用负状态码段）
en: n — total vertices of contour and holes
si — status codes (1/-1/0; holes use negative segments)

desc.zh: PRISM 的增强版，支持多个轮廓与洞口（把带洞的截面一次挤出）。沙盒目前按单轮廓处理，洞口请以 Archicad 为准。
desc.en: The extended form of PRISM supporting multiple contours and holes. The sandbox currently handles a single contour; verify holes in Archicad.

commands.name: EXTRUDE
commands.syntax: EXTRUDE n, dx, dy, dz, mask, x1, y1, s1, … , xn, yn, sn

zh: dx, dy, dz — 挤出向量（三个分量不能全为 0）
mask — 端面/侧面可见性掩码
si — 顶点状态码：1 起点、0 中间点、-1 终点
en: dx, dy, dz — extrusion vector (not all zero)
si — vertex status: 1 first, 0 intermediate, -1 last

desc.zh: 把截面沿任意方向的向量挤出，是 PRISM（只能沿 +Z）的通用版。截面仍在 x-y 平面，挤出方向由向量决定，做斜向挑檐、坡道、斜撑最顺手。沙盒忽略 mask，零向量会报错。
desc.en: Extrudes a profile along an arbitrary vector — the general form of PRISM, which can only go up +Z. The profile stays in the x-y plane while the vector sets the direction; ideal for slanted canopies, ramps and braces. The sandbox ignores mask and rejects a zero vector.

commands.name: REVOLVE
commands.syntax: REVOLVE n, alpha, mask, x1, y1, s1, … , xn, yn, sn

zh: alpha — 旋转角度（度，可负；不能为 0）
mask — 端面/侧面可见性掩码
xi, yi — 截面顶点，yi 必须 ≥ 0（就是半径）
si — 顶点状态码：1 起点、0 中间点、-1 终点
en: alpha — sweep angle in degrees (may be negative, not zero)
xi, yi — profile vertices; yi must be ≥ 0 (it is the radius)
si — vertex status: 1 first, 0 intermediate, -1 last

desc.zh: 截面绕 X 轴旋转成回转体：截面画在 x-y 平面，x 是轴向位置、y 是半径，y 不能为负。做柱础、花瓶、圆角线脚最省事；想让轴线立起来，先 `ROT 0, 90, 0`。沙盒忽略 mask，非整周时自动补端盖。
desc.en: Revolves a profile around the X axis: draw it in the x-y plane where x is the axial position and y the radius (never negative). Great for column bases, vases and mouldings; add `ROT 0, 90, 0` first to stand the axis up. The sandbox ignores mask and caps partial sweeps.

zh: dx, dy, dz — 沿三个轴的平移量
en: dx, dy, dz — offsets along the three axes

desc.zh: 把当前坐标系平移到新位置并压栈。后续几何都相对于新原点。用完记得 DEL 回退。
desc.en: Translates the current coordinate system and pushes it on the stack. Later geometry is relative to the new origin; pop it with DEL when done.

desc.zh: 等价于 `ADD dx, 0, 0` 的简写。ADDY / ADDZ 同理。
desc.en: Shorthand for `ADD dx, 0, 0`; ADDY / ADDZ work the same way.

desc.zh: 等价于 `ADD 0, dy, 0`。
desc.en: Equivalent to `ADD 0, dy, 0`.

desc.zh: 等价于 `ADD 0, 0, dz`。
desc.en: Equivalent to `ADD 0, 0, dz`.

commands.name: ROT

zh: x, y, z — 绕三个轴的旋转角（度）
en: x, y, z — rotation angles in degrees

desc.zh: 按 X → Y → Z 的顺序旋转当前坐标系并压栈。角度用度不是弧度；连续 ROT 会层层叠加，容易转乱，建议每轮做完就 DEL。
desc.en: Rotates the current coordinate system in X → Y → Z order and pushes it. Angles are degrees; consecutive ROT calls accumulate, so pop with DEL each round.

commands.example:
FOR i = 1 TO 6
  ROT 0, 0, i * 60
  ADD 1.2, 0, 0
  BLOCK 0.2, 0.1, 0.5
  DEL 2
NEXT i

zh: angle — 绕 X 轴角度（度）

desc.zh: 只绕 X 轴旋转，等价于 `ROT angle, 0, 0`。
desc.en: Rotate around X only; same as `ROT angle, 0, 0`.

zh: angle — 绕 Y 轴角度（度）

desc.zh: 只绕 Y 轴旋转，等价于 `ROT 0, angle, 0`。
desc.en: Rotate around Y only; same as `ROT 0, angle, 0`.

zh: angle — 绕 Z 轴角度（度）

desc.zh: 只绕 Z 轴旋转，平面阵列排版最常用。
desc.en: Rotate around Z only; the usual choice for radial layouts.

zh: sx, sy, sz — 三个轴的比例因子
en: sx, sy, sz — scale factors per axis

desc.zh: 对当前坐标系做非等比缩放并压栈。它改的是「单位」不是「尺寸」——之后所有坐标（包括 ADD 的位移）都会被一起缩放。
desc.en: Scales the current coordinate system and pushes it. It changes the unit, so every later coordinate (including ADD offsets) is scaled too.

desc.zh: 等价于 `MUL sx, 1, 1`。
desc.en: Equivalent to `MUL sx, 1, 1`.

desc.zh: 等价于 `MUL 1, sy, 1`。
desc.en: Equivalent to `MUL 1, sy, 1`.

desc.zh: 等价于 `MUL 1, 1, sz`。
desc.en: Equivalent to `MUL 1, 1, sz`.

zh: n — 回退的层数；省略则退 1 层；`DEL TOP` 退到栈底
en: n — levels to pop; omitted means 1; `DEL TOP` clears to the root

desc.zh: 变换栈出栈，恢复到 n 层之前的坐标系。每个 ADD/ROT/MUL 都要配一个 DEL，否则出错是必然的。
desc.en: Pops n levels from the transformation stack. Every ADD/ROT/MUL needs a matching DEL; forgetting them is the most common source of wrong geometry.

desc.zh: 在 2D 脚本里从 (x1,y1) 到 (x2,y2) 画一条直线。2D 坐标 y 向上，单位与 3D 一致。
desc.en: Draws a line from (x1,y1) to (x2,y2) in the 2D script. The 2D y axis points up; units match the 3D script.

desc.zh: 用两个对角点画矩形。平面符号里最省事的轮廓画法。
desc.en: Draws a rectangle from two opposite corners; the quickest outline for a plan symbol.

desc.zh: 画整圆。四条腿的桌子在平面图上就是四个圆。
desc.en: Draws a full circle; a four-legged table becomes four circles in plan.

commands.name: ARC2
commands.syntax: ARC2 x, y, r, a1, a2

desc.zh: 画圆弧，从 a1 逆时针到 a2。角度用度，0° 指向 +X。
desc.en: Draws an arc from a1 counter-clockwise to a2, in degrees, with 0° pointing along +X.

desc.zh: 在平面符号上写字。字号、对齐由后续属性命令控制，沙盒只画内容不还原字体。
desc.en: Places text in the plan symbol. Size and alignment come from attribute commands; the sandbox renders the content only.

commands.name: POLY2_
commands.syntax: POLY2_ n, fill, x1, y1, s1, … , xn, yn, sn

zh: fill — 填充索引（0 为不填充）
si — 顶点状态码（1 起、0 中、-1 止）
en: si — status codes (1 start, 0 mid, -1 end)

desc.zh: 一次画出带填充属性的多边形，是平面符号做异形轮廓的主力。
desc.en: Draws a polygon with a fill attribute in one statement; the main tool for irregular plan outlines.

commands.name: HOTSPOT2
commands.syntax: HOTSPOT2 x, y, unID, type, dir

zh: x, y — 热点坐标（2D 符号空间）
unID — 热点编号，在对象内唯一
type — 1 / 2 / 3，分别对应主点、附加点、可编辑点
dir — 0 为固定点，1 / 2 为沿 X / Y 方向可拖动
en: x, y — hotspot position in 2D symbol space
unID — unique hotspot ID inside the object
type — 1 / 2 / 3 for main, additional and editable nodes
dir — 0 fixed, 1 / 2 draggable along X / Y

desc.zh: 在 2D 符号上定义一个热点（又称编辑点），不画任何图形。用户拖动热点即可改变参数，这是参数化对象「手拉改尺寸」的入口。热点必须与 3D 几何、参数联动一起设计，否则拖了没反应。
desc.en: Defines an editable hotspot (editing node) in the plan symbol without drawing geometry. Dragging it changes a parameter; combined with 3D geometry and parameter feedback it becomes the visible handles of a parametric object.

zh: x, y, z — 3D 空间点坐标
en: x, y, z — a point in 3D space

desc.zh: 把 3D 点按当前投影方式投到平面图上，自动跟随平面图旋转（PROJECT2 常与 GLOB 结合用）。沙盒不绘制投影结果。
desc.en: Projects a 3D point into the plan using the current projection, so the symbol follows the plan rotation. The sandbox does not draw projected output.

desc.zh: 2D 变换栈的平移，只影响后续 2D 图形，不影响 3D。
desc.en: Translates the 2D transformation stack; affects later 2D shapes only.

desc.zh: 旋转 2D 坐标系。做斜向布置的平面符号很方便。
desc.en: Rotates the 2D coordinate system; handy for angled plan symbols.

desc.zh: 2D 非等比缩放，常用于把同一套符号拉伸适配不同尺寸。
desc.en: Non-uniform 2D scaling, useful for stretching one symbol to different sizes.

desc.zh: 2D 变换栈出栈，和 3D 的 DEL 分开管理，互不干扰。
desc.en: Pops the 2D transformation stack; independent from the 3D stack.

desc.zh: 给后续几何体指定材质索引，索引对应 Archicad 项目里的材质表。沙盒用固定调色板近似显示，颜色与真实材质不一致。
desc.en: Assigns a material index to following geometry, referring to the project's material table. The sandbox uses a fixed palette, so colours differ from Archicad.

desc.zh: 指定后续线条使用的画笔颜色。3D 里控制轮廓线，2D 里控制线型颜色。
desc.en: Selects the pen colour for subsequent lines: contour edges in 3D, line colour in 2D.

commands.name: IF

zh: condition — 条件表达式（非 0 为真）

desc.zh: 块式或单行式条件分支。相等判断写 `=`，不是 `==`；比较可用 `<>`、`<`、`>`、`<=`、`>=`，并用 AND / OR 组合。
desc.en: Block or single-line conditional. Equality is `=`, not `==`; comparisons support `<>`, `<`, `>`, `<=`, `>=`, combined with AND / OR.

commands.example:
IF h > 1.0 THEN
  BLOCK 1, 1, h
ELSE
  BLOCK 1, 1, 1.0
ENDIF

commands.name: FOR
commands.syntax: FOR v = from TO to [STEP s] … NEXT [v]

desc.zh: 次数已知的循环。循环结束后变量仍保留（值为越过上限的第一个值），后面继续用要重新赋值。
desc.en: A counted loop. The variable survives after the loop with the first value past the limit, so re-initialise before reuse.

commands.example:
FOR i = 1 TO 4
  ADD 0.3, 0, 0
  BLOCK 0.05, 0.05, 0.7
  DEL 1
NEXT i

commands.name: WHILE

zh: condition — 循环条件（非 0 继续）

desc.zh: 条件为真就继续。必须在循环体里自己改条件变量，否则死循环；沙盒有 10000 次保险丝，真实 Archicad 会卡死。
desc.en: Loops while the condition holds. You must update the condition variable yourself; the sandbox has a 10000-iteration fuse, real Archicad simply hangs.

commands.example:
z = 0
WHILE z < 1.8
  ADD 0, 0, z
  BLOCK 0.9, 0.3, 0.02
  DEL 1
  z = z + 0.4
ENDWHILE

commands.name: GOSUB

zh: label — 子程序入口标签名
en: label — entry label of the subroutine

desc.zh: 跳到标签处执行子程序，遇到 RETURN 回到调用点。标签写在行首，后面加冒号：`build_leg:`。
desc.en: Jumps to a labelled subroutine and returns at RETURN. Write the label at line start followed by a colon: `build_leg:`.

commands.example:
GOSUB draw_leg
END

draw_leg:
  CYLIND 0.7, 0.03
RETURN

commands.name: RETURN

desc.zh: 从子程序返回调用点。没有对应 GOSUB 时执行 RETURN 会报错，也常被用来给主脚本收尾。
desc.en: Returns from a subroutine. A RETURN without a matching GOSUB raises an error and is often used to finish the main script.

commands.example:
GOSUB draw_leg
END

draw_leg:
  CYLIND 0.7, 0.03
RETURN

desc.zh: 立即结束脚本，不再执行后面的行。子程序通常放在 END 之后，避免主流程执行时误入。
desc.en: Stops the script immediately. Put subroutines after END so the main flow cannot fall into them.
